coverage.canonical_policy: within each current-generation reported cohort, first observed row per target_date x game_pk; later successful snapshots cannot replace an earlier failure
coverage.interpretation: performance describes a selected analyzable universe; inspect current-generation first-observation unique-game and trigger/phase slices before assuming rejection missingness is random

semantics.eligible: native prediction generated; this is analyzability, not betting authorization
semantics.fully_market_observable: prediction generated with verified-fresh canonical market, sharp market selections, and execution market selections

feature_ownership.policy: one canonical probability-bearing feature family -> one production owner; distinct residual transforms require distinct IDs

data_quality.interpretation: operational_status measures evidence/data plumbing only; it never authorizes betting

execution_and_clv.interpretation: Paper/system-authorized outcomes are not user-realized ROI. Execution quality must be evaluated separately from prediction quality.

guardrails: No sample-size threshold alone certifies betting.
No dashboard field authorizes a wager; certification remains authoritative.
Missing ROI/CLV stays null rather than being inferred.
Champion, paper/system-authorized and real execution evidence remain distinct.

notes: Sharp/coin comparisons are paired on identical settled games.
Named variants are scored only when prospectively persisted in research_variants.
Regime slices are descriptive and must not be mined post-hoc into production rules.
